title: The role picker (Designer / Developer / Writer / SEO/GEO) is governed by the preset-picker switch, off by default, at both choosers Tracy draws
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout (dependencies installed, a Chrome or Playwright Chromium available) run: node --test --test-timeout=120000 packages/ui/tracy-mode-picker/test/e2e/preset-picker-switch.test.mjs packages/core/tracy-core/test/ui-switches.test.mjs
S2: Read the pass/fail counts and the tests named below.
expect: 'the door unreachable: the default (off) holds, no preset chooser is drawn' passes: 0 .tv-mode-picker and 0 .tv-role-chip.
'preset-picker hidden by the operator: no preset chooser is drawn' passes.
'preset-picker turned on: both the hero seat and the composer role chip are drawn' passes: 1 of each.
'preset-picker: off by default, in the composer group, drawn by Tracy' passes.
evidence: 13/10/2026 (screenshot of cowork.tracy.site): the Designer picker in the message box had no switch on /ops › User Interface.
fence: usePresetPickerShown in packages/ui/tracy-mode-picker/src/client/index.tsx, read by Seat and RoleChip; the catalogue's defaultOn false

tests: the door unreachable: the default (off) holds, no preset chooser is drawn
preset-picker hidden by the operator: no preset chooser is drawn
preset-picker turned on: both the hero seat and the composer role chip are drawn
preset-picker: off by default, in the composer group, drawn by Tracy
